name: Gauth
summary: AI homework helper for maths and other subjects, with an AI calculator and live tutors.
description: Gauth is a homework helper that helps with problems across subjects, offers an AI calculator, explains steps and offers live tutors. A Pro tier with a free trial was shown on the site. The site promotes an AI Pro subscription alongside free homework help.

howToUse.title: Open Gauth
howToUse.description: Go to Gauth and start with a homework problem. It is a homework helper.

howToUse.title: Use the calculator and the explained steps
howToUse.description: Work problems across subjects with the AI calculator, and read the steps it explains.

howToUse.title: Ask a tutor or compare the Pro subscription
howToUse.description: Use the live tutors when you want a person. A Pro tier with a trial was shown, and the site promotes that subscription alongside homework help.
